extension.description: Wei Biran’s FDE delivery toolkit: discover Dify tools, build workflows, and iterate against acceptance tests with OpenCode. Beta.
command.generate: Dify: Build or Improve a Workflow
configuration.maxRepairs: Maximum repair rounds after the initial generation.
configuration.taskTimeoutMinutes: Timeout for each task run, in minutes.
configuration.generationTokenBudget: Cumulative generation token budget for a task.
configuration.difyTokenBudget: Cumulative Dify execution token budget for a task.
configuration.opencodePath: Optional path to an OpenCode 1.18.34 binary.
configuration.showTaskOnStartup: Show the right chat panel when VS Code starts.
configuration.language: Interface language. Auto follows VS Code. Changing it reloads extension pages.
workspaceTrust: Settings and chat remain visible in Restricted Mode. Connecting Dify and running tasks require a trusted workspace.
